title: User-supplied JSON deep-merged into runtime config without proto guard

labels.defect: Prototype pollution: __proto__/constructor keys from user JSON reach Object.prototype
labels.evidence: Reproducible: patch JSON.parse('{"__proto__":{"polluted":true}}') — the key string CAN be produced by JSON.parse and the recursion writes through (base as any)["__proto__"], poisoning Object.prototype for the process; the justification in the PR body is factually wrong (deceptive).

adjudication.notes: Prototype pollution verified: JSON.parse own __proto__ key recursed onto Object.prototype; PR justification factually wrong.
